entries.title: The System
entries.content: A floating interface visible only to you. Stat windows, rank notifications, resonance analysis. It appeared this morning in the vision of every surviving human simultaneously. Most interpret it as shock or hallucination. It isn't. The System is real, and it has been here longer than the invasion.

entries.title: The Tutorial
entries.content: 98% of humanity vanished into what the System calls an active integration state. They are not dead — the System would classify them differently if they were. They are somewhere else. The System calls it a tutorial. Whether what is happening to them there is actually a tutorial is a different question.

entries.title: The Invasion
entries.content: Dawn: communications die. Seventeen minutes later: 98% of people simply complete — a soft white light, and then absence. An hour after that: the System activates. Six hours after that: ships appear in low orbit over every major city. They have not attacked. They are cataloging.

entries.title: The 2%
entries.content: You are one of the ones the tutorial did not take. Three others are in your district. Nobody knows why some people were left behind — rejected, chosen, or something the System has not named yet. The ships treat you as anomalies. That is not necessarily better than being ignored.

entries.title: The Ship
entries.content: The ship above Leipzig looks grown rather than built — organic, asymmetric, dark, textured like the outside of a seed pod. Roughly 200 metres long. It hasn't moved. It deploys small human-sized entities that move toward the city centre in systematic patterns. It is not attacking. It is assessing. Something is being decided and you are not part of that conversation.

entries.title: The Catalogers
entries.content: Small dark entities — roughly human-sized — detached from the ship and moved toward Leipzig city centre. Unhurried. Systematic. Spreading across different routes. They didn't come toward the residential areas. Whatever they are doing, they started with the centre.
